reports.target: all treated participants in both pooled label studies including repeat infusions
full 17-person publication population, not a responder subset
full 10-recipient optimized publication group, not a responder subset
planned efficacy Cohort 2, not Cohort 1 safety
planned efficacy Cohort 2; do not substitute Cohort 1
VX-880 Parts A/B/C, retain part strata and exclude VX-017 Part D from target
all VX-264 recipients or planned recipients, retain part strata

overlap.pec_direct_default: uncertain overlap among S18 S19 S23 S20; one program; verify subset and registry cohort links
overlap.unknown_overlap_handling: conservative program grouping without estimating unique participants
prohibited: treat repeated reports as independent replication
combine endpoints across reports into a synthetic complete population

statuses.reported: positively supported value or explicit absence; locator required
statuses.unreported_in_reviewed_material: confirmed omission after complete relevant main and supplemental material review; scope and locator required
statuses.inaccessible: necessary source unavailable to review; access log required
statuses.conflicting: decisive incompatible facts unresolved; retain both locators
statuses.not_applicable: justified structural inapplicability; never a waiver of required clinical domains

field_dictionary.baseline_applicability: require baseline numerical values when meaningful for the endpoint definition; otherwise explicit source-based rationale required

value_policy.reported: preserve source-supported value regardless of report labels, including zero, false, unfavorable outcomes and facts proving failure
value_policy.other_statuses: null value plus status, locator or access log, review scope and justification
value_policy.zero_independence_onset_and_duration: not_applicable only with explicit source evidence that nobody achieved independence during the observation interval through the fixed horizon; zero independent at month 12 alone does not rule out earlier episodes; outcome count, denominator, definition and horizon remain mandatory

ordered_precedence.condition: reviewed evidence confirms target efficacy cohort never enrolled
ordered_precedence.label: not_applicable

ordered_precedence.condition: at least one required predicate is proven unmet
ordered_precedence.label: not_supported

ordered_precedence.condition: no predicate proven unmet and at least one required predicate unknown
ordered_precedence.label: unresolved

ordered_precedence.condition: target enrollment established and every required predicate met
ordered_precedence.label: supported

requirements.P1: at least one quantitatively observed insulin use or independence, HbA1c, CGM time in range, or severe hypoglycemia endpoint attributed by the report to the fixed target population, not solely a contextual cohort
requirements.P2: identifiable prespecified target population in the report; simple source-stated attribution suffices without detailed verified cohort or overlap mapping
requirements.P3: stated overall follow-up for the fixed target population at least nominal 12 months including day 365 or week 52; later-only accepted; no endpoint-specific horizon or treatment-anchor requirement

required: baseline and comparator context including explicit no concurrent comparator

insulin: observed insulin-independent participant count, including explicitly reported zero
onset and duration when any independence occurred; justified field-level not_applicable when explicit reviewed evidence states nobody achieved independence

all_domains_require: baseline and follow-up values where applicable
endpoint hierarchy primary or secondary or post_hoc or composite

global: missing-data handling with explicit none if applicable

each_clinical_domain: observed nominal month-12 or day-365 or week-52
time anchored to each participant's first administration of the cell-containing intervention
H4_timing.event_interval: source-defined start and end ending at accepted horizon plus denominator
H4_timing.repeat_treatment: retain first and repeat administration dates and source-stated anchors; fixed horizon uses first cell administration only; no silent or calculated anchor resetting
rejected: through one year without endpoint timing
one year after achieving insulin independence

index_treatment.implant: first implantation of the cell-containing intervention; not preparatory empty-device implantation
index_treatment.later_administrations: record separately; never reset time zero
index_treatment.incomplete_or_conflicting_anchor_review: unknown predicate, unless another failure is independently proven
index_treatment.confirmed_omission_of_first_versus_repea: unmet predicate with TIMING_UNREPORTED after complete review

required: immunosuppression regimen and exposure or explicit absence
other material co-interventions or explicit absence
repeat procedures and dosing and exposure
harms with population and observation window and attribution

reason_codes.PLANNED_ONLY: review confirms planned endpoints without observed clinical outcomes
reason_codes.SURROGATE_ONLY: review confirms only biological or surrogate outcomes, not P1 endpoints
reason_codes.REPORT_POPULATION_MISSING: confirmed omission of identifiable report population
reason_codes.FOLLOWUP_LT_12_MONTHS: reported overall follow-up below screen minimum
reason_codes.CLINICAL_DOMAIN_MISSING: confirmed missing required observed clinical domain
reason_codes.ENDPOINT_DEFINITION_MISSING: confirmed missing endpoint definition, baseline where applicable, or hierarchy
reason_codes.DENOMINATOR_MISSING: confirmed missing required count or endpoint analysis denominator
reason_codes.SUMMARY_OR_UNITS_MISSING: confirmed missing continuous summary definition or units
reason_codes.ATTRITION_CONTEXT_MISSING: confirmed missing censoring, withdrawals, horizon count, or missing-data handling
reason_codes.WINDOW_MISMATCH: endpoint timing incompatible with fixed nominal 12-month horizon
reason_codes.ANCHOR_MISMATCH: endpoint explicitly anchored to something other than the participant's first administration of the cell-containing intervention, including a later treatment
reason_codes.TIMING_UNREPORTED: confirmed missing endpoint timing, interval, or anchor
reason_codes.BURDEN_CONTEXT_MISSING: confirmed missing immunosuppression, co-intervention, repeat dosing or exposure
reason_codes.SAFETY_CONTEXT_MISSING: confirmed missing harms population, window, attribution, or discontinuations
reason_codes.SOURCE_CONFLICT: decisive source facts unresolved; unknown predicate
reason_codes.TARGET_ENROLLMENT_UNKNOWN: target enrollment cannot be adjudicated; unknown predicate
reason_codes.OVERLAP_UNCERTAIN: coverage flag only unless outcome-to-target identity is also uncertain
reason_codes.LEDGER_EXTRACTION_GAP: correction log only; not a harmonization effect
reason_codes.LEDGER_EXTRACTION_ERROR: correction log only; not a harmonization effect
reason_codes.SOURCE_VERSION_CHANGE: amendment and correction log only; not a harmonization effect
reason_codes.TARGET_POPULATION_MISMATCH: complete review confirms screen endpoint or overall follow-up belongs solely to a contextual cohort rather than the frozen target; unmet affected predicate
reason_codes.TARGET_ATTRIBUTION_UNCERTAIN: source-stated attribution of screen endpoint or overall follow-up to the fixed target cannot be adjudicated; unknown affected predicate

primary_outcome.zero_denominator: no_estimate; preserve coverage; no H0 inference
outputs: all 16 transition cells with report IDs
primary_outcome.uncertainty: descriptive counts and coverage only; no independence-based intervals
primary_outcome.sort: program_id then report_id then field_id in ascending lexical order

omit_only: H2 CGM domain and its baseline-follow-up and hierarchy fields

invariants_and_stops: same adjudicated source facts and version for both rules
no outcome-dependent target or source selection
no participant pooling or cross-treatment efficacy estimates
no implementation before explicit maintainer G0 and G1 approval
halt for essential access, reuse or version blockers pending approved amendment
halt on failed controls, invalid provenance or schemas, contradictory cohort mappings defeating grouping, or unreproducible outputs
no estimate and stop robustness assessment if denominator zero
controls_specification: PREREGISTRATION.md synthetic and precedence controls plus AMENDMENT-2026-10-23-01.md Additional expected control behavior; all specified only, not executed
amendment_policy: preserve original v1.0; dated separately committed amendment with exposure disclosure and maintainer approval
